name: data-manager-api-troubleshooting
description: Diagnoses and fixes errors, warnings, and missing data for Data Manager API event and audience ingestion requests. Use when an IngestEvents, IngestAudienceMembers, RemoveAudienceMembers, RemoveAllAudienceMembers, or RetrieveRequestStatus call fails (INVALID_ARGUMENT, REQUIRED_FIELD_MISSING, INVALID_HEX_ENCODING, PERMISSION_DENIED, UNAUTHENTICATED, RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED, INVALID_REQUEST_ID), when a response has fieldWarnings, when checking request status or diagnostics, when request status shows FAILED or PARTIAL_SUCCESS or processing errors, when finding which records failed, or when a request returned 200 but conversions or audience members are missing. Don't use for writing new ingestion code (use the data-manager-api-event-ingestion or data-manager-api-audience-ingestion skills) or first-time credential setup (use the data-manager-api-setup skill).
author: google
